title: Concrete Forest Reference Fixture Scope
description: Load ref-concrete-forest only when concrete forest fixture is active, replicated across all CAD play model definitions.
summary: Scoped ref-concrete-forest to concrete forest fixtures only (concrete-forest-left/right). Default play state has no references. When a concrete forest fixture loads, the reference is replicated across all quad model definitions (shape, building, energy, structure classic). Other fixtures and raw loads clear references.
